generation_placement.source: concept scarp/highland world-space masks and actual terrain height/slope
generation_placement.cross_chunk: shared absolute world sampling, not per-chunk independent placement
generation_placement.terrain_contact: crest level meets upper terrain, toe meets lower terrain; optional deterministic plateau/ramp adjustment

render.decorative_cliff_colliders: none unless justified, use gameplay terrain colliders
render.batching_instancing: measure in Unity; do not assume eligible
